column1: # Real issue titles and the area labels people gave them, for
# tests/test-4144-area-labels.ps1. Read from the board's open issues on
# 12 Nov 2026, each area's first issues in Order (#4144). Issues that carried
# only "area: triage" are left out: nobody had said their area yet.
# "area: CI" and "area: deploy" are written as GitHub & CI and Operations,
# the labels they fold into. One issue a line: number, a tab, its areas with
# | between them, a tab, its title. A line starting # is a comment.
